note: Multipart support (vespera::multipart, vespera::tempfile, #[derive(Multipart)], schema_type!(..., multipart)) moved behind the new default-on `multipart` cargo feature. Default builds are unaffected; builds with default-features = false that use multipart must add features = ["multipart"] (without it #[derive(Multipart)] is a compile error naming the feature). Dropping the feature removes tempfile, multer, encoding_rs and their dependencies; axum-extra/multipart moved from the default list into the feature.
